comments: Searches entity types with the specified criteria and pagination.

params.name: name
comments: The name of the entity type to search for. Use * to return all entity types.

params.name: numberOfResults
comments: (Optional) The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

params.name: orderBy
comments: (Optional) The field to order the results by. Supported values: insertInstant, lastUpdateInstant, name.

params.name: startRow
comments: (Optional) The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.
